record.question: The system 900/[s(s+1)(s+9)] is to be such that its gain-crossover frequency becomes same as its uncompensated phase crossover frequency and provides a 45° phase margin. To achieve this, one may use
options: a lag compensator that provides an attenuation of 20 dB and a phase lag of 45° at the frequency of 3√3 rad/s.
a lead compensator that provides an amplification of 20 dB and a phase lead of 45° at the frequency of 3 rad/s.
a lag-lead compensator that provides an amplification of 20 dB and a phase lag of 45° at the frequency of √3 rad/s.
a lag-lead compensator that provides an attenuation of 20 dB and phase lead of 45° at the frequency of 3 rad/s.
